items.description: Laptop accidental damage repair (cracked screen and lower-right corner), combined line
items.rationale: Damage from a swerve inside a car is expressly covered (2.6.1, 2.6.2), and screen plus corner damage is one loss on one unit (2.6.3, 7.1.12); direct settlement with the shop does not change cover. No purchase price or deductible is stated, so the estimate is calibrated on reference cases 2 and 5 (screen ≥808 + corner ≥342; combined ≥1166), giving roughly EUR 1,200 gross.
